name: Submodule.natAbs_det_equiv
statement: Submodule ℤ M) {E : Type*} [EquivLike E M N] [AddEquivClass E M N] (e : E) : Int.natAbs (LinearMap.det (N.subtype ∘ₗ AddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap (e : M →+ N))) = Nat.card (M ⧸ N)

name: AddSubgroup.index_eq_natAbs_det
statement: Type*} [AddCommGroup E] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (bE : Basis ι ℤ E) (N : AddSubgroup E) (bN : Basis ι ℤ N) : N.index = (bE.det (bN ·)).natAbs
